# MovementModule

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Movement.Runtime` · assembly `VRFramework.Movement.Runtime` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Runtime/Scripts/Movement/MovementModule.cs#L19)

The movement module. Lets the player move themselves between marked standing places by
holding a palm up, aiming along a thrown arc and closing a fist. Registers itself as
[`IMovementService`](/api/vrframework-core-runtime/IMovementService).

The gesture is deliberately one the hands do not make by accident: a palm turned to the
sky, which is neither how anyone holds a tool nor how they gesture while talking.

```csharp
public class MovementModule : VRModule, IMovementService
```

### TeleportTo(Component) {#teleportto-component}

Moves the player to a standing place, as if they had aimed at it. Ignores
[`CanTeleport`](/api/vrframework-core-runtime/IMovementService#canteleport), since the caller is the one deciding.
